en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned panoramic photograph of Sundsvall, with a prominent view over the town and its harbor (hamnen). The front image displays the town, waterfront, and ships in the bay, with wooded hills in the foreground. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, address lines, and printed information about the publisher (Nygrens, Sundsvall) along with a price ('Pris 15 Öre').
